feature: US date order, PR 3 (admin dates): every admin slot that draws a date, at its longest realistic value
note: Run on a scratch branch made from local-dev, against a server started with ADMIN_USER_IDS naming the audit account and ADMIN_ENV_LABEL=staging. Seeded: a model_calls row copied to 2025-12-31 18:00 UTC (local-dev already has one in 2026-09), so the Costs period line and trend stamp draw `Dec 1 to 31` / `by Dec 31` and `Sep 1 to 30` / `by Sep 30`; HELP_ME_CHOOSE_ENABLED overrides (app 2026-09-30 14:02, group 2026-09-30 23:59, account 2025-12-31 23:59) with their admin_events; the `date-probe` group (d47e0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001) with group_created 2025-12-31 23:59 and member_added 2026-09-30 14:02; invites_set and account_revealed events on ${DATE_ACCOUNT}. fmtWhen carries no year, so `Sep 30 · 14:02` and `Dec 31 · 23:59` are its longest forms. The workspace read stamp (`Oct 17, 14:05 UTC`) needs ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY and a read from another day, so it is not photographed.
